caption: Archers shoot into the east face of a 60-man infantry square that holds its ground. When a man falls, the men behind him in his file step forward to close the gap and the rear rank fills in behind, so everyone else keeps his place in the ring; a volley that drops several may instead shift whole ranks a file over. Either way no man is sent across the square. Before this fix every man behind a fallen one moved up one place in roster order, so a man from each rank was sent across the square to the far end of the rank ahead, and the square slid 35 wu west under fire.
